Components.Name: SceneAxes
Components.Description: The three axes of a view: how a world stands to the eye; a press on one tells which.

Props.Name: Yaw
Props.Description: The turn of the view round the height, in radians.

Props.Name: Pitch
Props.Description: How far above its middle the eye stands, in radians.

Props.Name: Size
Props.Description: Its side in pixels.

Props.Name: Labels
Props.Description: Writes the letters of the axes.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: The name of it for screen readers.

EventDescriptions.axis: An end of an axis was pressed: {Axis, Sign}.

Components.Name: SceneObject
Components.Description: An object of a game of any kind: its Kind gives its traits and parts, every other attribute is a field of it.

Props.Name: ID
Props.Description: The ID of the object.

Props.Name: Kind
Props.Description: Its kind (the Kinds Service): planet, station, fleet, tree, or one of your own.

Props.Name: Name
Props.Description: Its name.

Props.Name: Part
Props.Description: The part of its parent it changes (the part of that ID of the kind of the parent).

Props.Name: Parent
Props.Description: What it goes round or belongs to, when not the object it is declared in.

Props.Name: Team
Props.Description: Its team.

Props.Name: X
Props.Description: Its place across (a cell of a map).

Props.Name: Y
Props.Description: Its place down (a cell of a map).

Props.Name: Width
Props.Description: The cells it takes across.

Props.Name: Height
Props.Description: The cells it takes down.

Props.Name: Color
Props.Description: Its color.

Props.Name: Image
Props.Description: A picture of it, standing on its cell.

Props.Name: Blocks
Props.Description: No way through it.

Props.Name: Opaque
Props.Description: It hides what is behind it.

Components.Name: Scene
Components.Description: The scene of a game in 3D: objects of any kind with their traits and parts; the setting space brings a star system on Kepler orbits, stations and fleets, with a landing on the surfaces of its bodies; the setting terrain a ground of noise and its walkers.

Props.Name: Setting
Props.Description: The setting: its kinds and systems (space: a star system; terrain: a ground and its walkers).

Props.Name: System
Props.Description: The objects: {Objects: [{ID, Kind, Parent, Values, Traits, Parts, Children}]}.

Props.Name: Seed
Props.Description: A whole star system made of a seed (always the same for the same seed).

Props.Name: Systems
Props.Description: Systems of the application for traits of its own: {Trait: {Update(object, scene), Draw(object, scene)}}.

Props.Name: Time
Props.Description: The day of the scene.

Props.Name: Speed
Props.Description: The days of the scene a second.

Props.Name: Capture
Props.Description: With a walker under the keys (Control), a press takes the pointer: the mouse turns the view, Escape gives it back.

Props.Name: Person
Props.Description: Where the view of a walker stands: behind it (third), in its eyes (first, its head hidden but its body and what it holds seen) or over its shoulder. V changes it while the pointer is taken.

Props.Name: Shoulder
Props.Description: Over which shoulder the view stands. B changes it while the pointer is taken.

Props.Name: Axes
Props.Description: The corner where the Axes of the view stand, none when empty; a press on one looks along it.

Props.Name: Origin
Props.Description: Draws the three axes of the world at its middle (and the colliders as their outlines).

Props.Name: Wireframe
Props.Description: Draws the wire of the scene over it: each edge of the ground and of the models (--elemenx-scene-wire).

Props.Name: Edges
Props.Description: Draws the edges of the models: where their faces meet at an angle and their rims (--elemenx-scene-edges).

Props.Name: Hovered
Props.Description: The ID of the object under the pointer, outlined (--elemenx-scene-hover) as the selected one is (--elemenx-scene-outline).

Props.Name: FreeLook
Props.Description: A walker that stands does not turn with the view, so it can be looked at from all sides: it comes round when it sets off.

Props.Name: DaySeconds
Props.Description: The seconds a day of 24 hours takes, on a body and from space alike, however fast the orbits go (0: as Speed says).

Props.Name: SurfaceSpeed
Props.Description: The days a second on the surface of a body (1/120: a day of two minutes).

Props.Name: Shadows
Props.Description: The shadows of a sun on a ground, a surface and a model near the view (true).

Props.Name: Quality
Props.Description: What the light costs: empty chooses by the graphics card and steps down while frames are late.

Props.Name: Pipeline
Props.Description: The render graph of the Blueprints Service that makes the picture of a frame (high, ultra and medium): its passes (Scene, Clouds, Occlusion, Air, Frames, Mirror, Rays, Exposure, Bokeh, Bloom, Picture, Shader: a pass graph of its own) up to Present; empty: PipelineGraph(), the passes of the library.

Props.Name: PipelineParameters
Props.Description: The values of the parameters of the Pipeline, by key.

Props.Name: Flare
Props.Description: How strongly the rings and the glow a lens makes of the sun show, at high and ultra: 0 to 2 (true is 1).

Props.Name: Weather
Props.Description: What the air of a ground does; it changes in a few seconds, as a front comes; changing goes from one to the next by itself.

Props.Name: Wind
Props.Description: How strong the wind is, 0 to 4, for clouds, rain, grass and trees (empty: as the weather has it).

Props.Name: WindWay
Props.Description: Where the wind blows to: an azimuth in degrees.

Props.Name: WaterGraph
Props.Description: What water looks like: a water graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON, or its GLSL) of its waves, the sky and the sun it mirrors, its depth, its foam and the fog over it; the one of the library (LibraryWater) when empty.

Props.Name: LandGraph
Props.Description: What the land is, its light and its wet and snow too: a land graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON, or GLSL with blueprintLand); empty, the one of the library (LibraryLand()). Its Blueprint (a material graph) still paints it, in LandPaint.

Props.Name: SkyGraph
Props.Description: What the sky is: a sky graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON, or GLSL with blueprintSky); empty, the one of the library (LibrarySky()).

Props.Name: GrassGraph
Props.Description: How the wind leans the grass: a vertex graph as WindGraph (or its JSON, or GLSL); empty, the one of the library (LibraryGrass()).

Props.Name: WindGraph
Props.Description: How the wind bends what grows and sways: a vertex graph of the Blueprints Service (or its JSON, or its GLSL), the one of the library (LibraryWind) when empty; the Vertex of a material runs after it.

Props.Name: Front
Props.Description: The seconds a change of the weather takes.

Props.Name: View
Props.Description: A ground seen in parallel rays, as a game of two dimensions: from above or at an angle (empty: in perspective).

Props.Name: Paused
Props.Description: Holds the time.

Props.Name: Loader
Props.Description: Shows how much of the scene has come; a slot named loading takes its place.

Props.Name: Focus
Props.Description: The ID of the object in the middle of the view.

Props.Name: Selected
Props.Description: The ID of the selected object.

Props.Name: Orbits
Props.Description: Draws the orbits.

Props.Name: Labels
Props.Description: Shows the names of the objects.

Props.Name: Exposure
Props.Description: What a view lets in: a number holds it, empty adapts to the light as an eye does.

Props.Name: Aurora
Props.Description: The northern lights, 0 to 1 (more is brighter): anywhere, at night; empty: by themselves at 55 to 68 degrees of Latitude of the sun, at night under a clear sky.

Props.Name: AuroraColors
Props.Description: The colors of the northern lights, under and over: ['#3dff9a', '#c03cff'].

Props.Name: Crosshair
Props.Description: The crosshair over the view while the hero holds a Weapon: empty as its weapon says, none for no crosshair.

Props.Name: MarkCount
Props.Description: How many marks of shots stay at once (the oldest go first).

Props.Name: MarkSeconds
Props.Description: How long a mark of a shot stays, in seconds.

Props.Name: Season
Props.Description: The season the land and its plants show: spring, summer, autumn or winter; empty: of the sun (its DayOfYear of YearDays at its Latitude), passing with the days.

Props.Name: Rainbow
Props.Description: A rainbow, 0 to 1, where the sun stands low behind the view; empty: the weather's, in a light rain or as it ends.

Props.Name: Cutscenes
Props.Description: The cutscenes of the scene by name ({Name: {Tracks, Restore, Skip, Loop}}, SceneCinema): PlayCutscene(name) plays one; Save and Load keep them.

Props.Name: Camera
Props.Description: The camera of the scene (an object of kind camera) that shows the world; empty: the view of the scene.

Props.Name: Bokeh
Props.Description: The depth of field, 0 to 1: how wide the lens is open; what is far from the focus is blurred, a bright point of it a disc.

Props.Name: BokehFocus
Props.Description: The distance in focus; empty: the hero, or what the middle of the view shows, followed slowly.

Props.Name: Details
Props.Description: Shows a card of the selected object.

Props.Name: Background
Props.Description: Draws the stars far away.

Props.Name: Cosmos
Props.Description: What lies far behind a system, made of a seed: nebula, pillars, galaxy, galaxies, cluster, void, or {Kind, Seed, Colors, Gas, Dust, Stars, Pillars, Band, Galaxies, Clusters, Beacon}: a kind is a set of these amounts, and what is told comes on top of it.

Props.Name: Scale
Props.Description: Large bodies and short distances (compressed), or their real sizes.

Props.Name: Team
Props.Description: The team of the player.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: The name of the scene for screen readers.

EventDescriptions.ready: The scene is ready: the component itself, to call its methods.
EventDescriptions.select: The selection changed: {ID, Object, Info, IDs, Objects} (ID empty when none is).
EventDescriptions.focus: The view moved to an object: {ID}.
EventDescriptions.person: V took the view of a walker to another place: third, first or shoulder.
EventDescriptions.loading: What the scene waits for came a step nearer: {Part (up to 100, never back), Stage (programs, models, globes, ground, plants, view; empty when done)}.
EventDescriptions.prepared: All the view needs is made and the veil goes: {First (the start of the scene, not a location that came)}.
EventDescriptions.shoulder: B took the view over another shoulder: right or left.
EventDescriptions.arrive: An object reached where it was sent: {ID, At}.
EventDescriptions.land: The view went down to the surface of a body: {ID}.
EventDescriptions.takeoff: The view went back up to space: {ID}.
EventDescriptions.travel: A ship on its way far at once (Travel, H or J) came to a phase: {ID, Kind (warp or jump), Phase (enter, inside, exit, done)}.
EventDescriptions.enter: A walker, a vehicle or the hero came into a trigger: {Trigger (the trigger itself: ID, Inside(), Action(name, data), Enable(on)), ID, Object}.
EventDescriptions.leave: One went out of a trigger, or was removed: {Trigger, ID, Object}.
EventDescriptions.action: A trigger was sent an action (Action of the trigger): {Trigger, Name, Data}.
EventDescriptions.dig: A hole was dug in the ground (Dig): {At, Radius}.
EventDescriptions.fire: An object shot its weapon (SceneWeapons): {ID, Weapon, From, Way}.
EventDescriptions.hit: A shot hit something or the ground (SceneWeapons): {ID, Weapon, Type, Source, Team, Target, Part, Point, Normal, Material, Amount, Distance}.
EventDescriptions.lock: The hero locked a target under its aim (Lock of its weapon): {ID, Weapon}.
EventDescriptions.break: A thing broke into pieces (Break, SceneDebris): {ID, Pieces, Point}.
EventDescriptions.teleport: A thing is beamed away or comes (Teleport): {ID, Phase (out or in), From, To}.
EventDescriptions.through: A ship flew into the mouth of a wormhole (SceneDeepSpace): {ID, Wormhole, Leads, To (the mouth it comes out of, empty: none)}.
EventDescriptions.hover: The pointer came over a selectable object, or left it: {ID (empty: none), Object, Info}.
EventDescriptions.cutscene: A cutscene started, ended or was stopped (SceneCinema): {Name, State: start, end or stop}.
EventDescriptions.cue: A cue of a cutscene came: {Cutscene, Name, Data, At}.
EventDescriptions.part: A part of an object was set by its role (Part(id, role).Set): {ID, Role, Value}.
EventDescriptions.touch: Two solid things began to touch (trait Rigid): {ID, With (null: the ground), At, Normal, Impulse}.
EventDescriptions.shader: A graph (or GLSL written by hand) made into a shader did not compile, and what the library has is drawn in its place: {Kind (material, vertex, land, water, wind, grass, effect, pass), Owner (the material, object or prop of the graph), Errors ([{Block, Line, Message}]: each on the block of GLSL it is in), Message}.

Components.Name: Drawing
Components.Description: A vector drawing: shapes, lines, arrows, freehand brushes and texts on layers, with groups and an export to SVG and PNG.

Props.Name: Value
Props.Description: The model: {Width, Height, Background, Layers: [{ID, Name, Visible, Locked, Items}]}.

Props.Name: Tool
Props.Description: The tool in hand.

Props.Name: Brush
Props.Description: The brush of the freehand tool.

Props.Name: Stroke
Props.Description: The color of the lines of new items.

Props.Name: Fill
Props.Description: The color inside new shapes (none: no fill).

Props.Name: StrokeWidth
Props.Description: The width of the lines in the units of the drawing.

Props.Name: Layer
Props.Description: The ID of the layer new items go into.

Props.Name: Toolbar
Props.Description: Shows the tools, the colors and the actions over it.

Props.Name: ReadOnly
Props.Description: Shows the drawing alone.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: What it shows, for screen readers.

EventDescriptions.select: The selection changed: the IDs of the items selected.

Components.Name: DrawingLayers
Components.Description: The layers of a Drawing: shown or hidden, locked, named, ordered.

Props.Name: Value
Props.Description: The model of the Drawing.

Props.Name: Layer
Props.Description: The ID of the current layer.

Props.Name: ReadOnly
Props.Description: Shows the layers without letting them change.

EventDescriptions.change: The layers changed: the model of the drawing.
EventDescriptions.select: A layer was chosen: its ID.

Components.Name: CutsceneEditor
Components.Description: An editor of the cutscenes of a Scene on a line of time: tracks, keys, titles, preview and recording.

Props.Name: Value
Props.Description: The cutscenes by name: {Name: {Tracks, Restore, Skip, Loop}}.

Props.Name: Scene
Props.Description: The Scene (the component) they play in.

Props.Name: Target
Props.Description: The object a move or a cut goes to by default.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: What it shows, for screen readers.

EventDescriptions.camera: Camera from view was pressed: {Props} of a camera where the view is.

Components.Name: SceneEditor
Components.Description: An editor of a game scene as Unreal edits a level: objects, kinds to add, the view with a gizmo, fields, blueprint parameters, Play.

Props.Name: Value
Props.Description: The document: {Version, Name, Setting, Scene (the recipe of Scene.Save)}.

Props.Name: Setting
Props.Description: What a new document is: a ground under a sun, or a star system.

Props.Name: Kinds
Props.Description: The kinds of objects to add on a ground.

Props.Name: SpaceKinds
Props.Description: The kinds of objects to add in a star system.

Props.Name: Models
Props.Description: Models of the Models Service to place on a ground (an ModelEditor's), each as the kind its Type fits: a unit, a house, a tree, a rock or a thing.

Props.Name: Storage
Props.Description: The key of localStorage Save keeps the document under.

Props.Name: SnapMove
Props.Description: The step of a move with Snap, in metres.

Props.Name: SnapTurn
Props.Description: The step of a turn with Snap, in degrees.

Props.Name: SnapScale
Props.Description: The step of a scale with Snap.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: What it shows, for screen readers.

Components.Name: PlanetEditor
Components.Description: An editor of a planet as a globe: continents, oceans, ranges, rivers, climates and lands drawn on it, its plates, winds and climate shown sharp at any distance.

Props.Name: Value
Props.Description: The planet: the options of ScenePlanet.Make.

Props.Name: Tool
Props.Description: The tool in hand.

Props.Name: Overlay
Props.Description: What is shown of the planet.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: What it shows, for screen readers.

EventDescriptions.change: The planet changed: the options of ScenePlanet.Make.
EventDescriptions.location: A location of the planet opened: {ID, Location} (SceneLocations.Location: its World, its place, its kind).
EventDescriptions.drawn: The picture of the view is whole: {Overlay}.

Components.Name: ModelEditor
Components.Description: An editor of a model made of shapes: parts in pieces with tags, mirrors and variants of a seed, a gizmo, the recipe of Models and its files glb, fbx and obj.

Props.Name: Value
Props.Description: The document: {Version, Name, Recipe (a recipe of data of Models: Parts, Pieces, Group, Type, Size...)}.

Props.Name: Variant
Props.Description: The variant shown: 0, the parts as they are; the others varied by their seed.

Props.Name: Generator
Props.Description: A generator of models: function (description, callback (error, recipe)).

Props.Name: Storage
Props.Description: The key of localStorage Save keeps the document under.

Props.Name: SnapMove
Props.Description: The step of a move with Snap, in sizes of the model.

Props.Name: SnapTurn
Props.Description: The step of a turn with Snap, in degrees.

Props.Name: SnapScale
Props.Description: The step of a scale with Snap.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: What it shows, for screen readers.

Props.Name: Wire
Props.Description: Shows the wire of the model: each edge of its triangles.

Props.Name: Edges
Props.Description: Shows the edges of the model: where its faces meet at an angle and its rims (true).

Props.Name: Mode
Props.Description: The tab shown: the parts of the recipe (shape), the roles of the parts of a model (roles) or what is done to its pieces (parts).

Props.Name: RoleModel
Props.Description: In the tab Roles, a model of a file of SceneModels whose roles are edited (ModelRoles keeps them); empty: the one of the document (its recipe keeps them, Roles).

Services.Name: Renderer
Services.Description: The graphics of three dimensions on WebGL2: a camera and a renderer of shapes with shaders.

Services.Name: Meshes
Services.Description: The shapes of three dimensions made of triangles: spheres, boxes, cylinders, lathes and the rest, moved, merged and simplified.

Services.Name: SceneKinds
Services.Description: The kinds of the objects of a game: what they extend, what they can do (Traits) and what they are made of (Parts).

Services.Name: SceneMaterials
Services.Description: The library of materials of a Scene: patterns of GLSL in metres of the world, for the ground, roads and models.

Services.Name: SceneTerrainGenerator
Services.Description: The ground of a game, continuous: heights of noise anywhere, meshes in chunks, ways over it; the ground of a planet as its surface shows.

Services.Name: BlueprintShaders
Services.Description: The graphs of Blueprints made into shaders and passes of a picture: the kinds pass, material and render.

Services.Name: SceneBlueprints
Services.Description: What a Scene adds to Blueprints: the graphs of effects and the blocks of the passes of its picture.

Services.Name: Gltf
Services.Description: glTF 2.0 and GLB: meshes, materials, skins and animations of the models other programs make.

Services.Name: Fbx
Services.Description: The files of FBX, binary and text: models with meshes, materials, pictures, skins and clips, read and written.

Services.Name: ModelFormats
Services.Description: The files of models read and written in one form: glb, gltf, fbx (binary and text) and obj.

Services.Name: Sigils
Services.Description: Magic circles of a seed, as data: rings of lines, ticks, dots, arcs, runes and stars, each with a turn of its own.

Services.Name: SceneRoads
Services.Description: The roads of a scene, of any kind: motorways, streets, country roads, race tracks, paths, runways and railways, their cross-sections, lines and models.
Methods: BarrierHit(roads, x, z, fromX, fromZ, hints, size)

Services.Name: SceneRoadGenerator
Services.Description: Roads made of a seed, the same each time: closed race tracks as roads of a Scene, with where they start.

Services.Name: SceneModels
Services.Description: The models of a game made of code: units, animals, plants, buildings and ships of pieces that move, fantasy and sci-fi, and their clips.

Services.Name: SceneMannequin
Services.Description: A person made wholly of code, as detailed as a model of a file: its skin, its skeleton of Mixamo and its clips.

Services.Name: ModelRoles
Services.Description: What the parts of a model are: wheels, steering, pedals, doors, lamps, levers, hatches; kept for each model, moved by a Scene.

Services.Name: SceneBuildingGenerator
Services.Description: Buildings of any size made of their numbers, from a shack to a business centre: models of the Models Service.

Services.Name: SceneBiomes
Services.Description: The lands of a game: the colors of a ground, what grows on it, and villages laid out on it.

Services.Name: SceneWaves
Services.Description: The waves of a sea as Gerstner waves: for the shader that draws them and for what floats on them.

Services.Name: SceneShowcase
Services.Description: One big world made of every primitive of the generation of a Scene: a demo and a benchmark.

Services.Name: SceneSower
Services.Description: What the Scatter of a Scene sows in squares of a ground, worked out in workers: the same things for the same seed.

Services.Name: SceneWorld
Services.Description: The world of a ground as a graph of its steps: the land, its relief, climate, biomes and sketch, and what is made on it.

Services.Name: ScenePlanet
Services.Description: A planet as one continuous function of a direction: painted continents, tectonic plates, winds, climate and biomes, as fine as it is asked.

Services.Name: SceneLocations
Services.Description: The locations of a planet: cells of its surface, each a scene in detail, their neighbours, passages between them and what is past their sides.
